**Handoff is at [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is `dep-4471`, the gateway config `connection-per-request for pool isolation`. It holds all 20 pool slots open. Every 503 carries `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED` with `in_use 20`.

Window runs `02:14:18Z` to log end at `03:59:27Z`, 105 minutes. 530 of 636 requests failed, 83%. Still failing when the log stops.

Roll back `dep-4471`. Also check `node-1` and `node-2`. This log covers only `node-3`.
